question: Should OpenClaw add public persisted rootSessionKey and session-chain traceId fields for spawned sessions, and should traceId be a new chain identifier or align with existing diagnostic/resolver trace context?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but these fields would become persisted session state and Gateway/tool API contract, and adjacent resolver lineage work is using similar terminology.

options.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
options.body: Add optional spawned-session parent/root/trace/depth metadata with additive schema, projections, docs, and tests, leaving traversal APIs for later.

options.title: Align With Resolver Lineage First
options.body: Keep this open until the sessions.resolve lineage semantics settle, then implement spawned-session metadata using shared terminology.

options.title: Reject Durable Root/Trace Fields
options.body: Keep current parent/depth behavior and limit future work to tooling or docs if maintainers do not want a new persisted chain identifier.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
recommendation.body: Add optional spawned-session parent/root/trace/depth metadata with additive schema, projections, docs, and tests, leaving traversal APIs for later.
